title: Utopia Conflict
package_scope: single Prototype Lab activity mode folder
validation_targets: modal help pause and gameplay-HUD isolation
notes: Pass55 repairs the pause/settings input dead-end without changing combat or world systems. The menu now has visible selection, W/S and Up/Down navigation, Enter/Space activation, Esc resume, and explicit absolute/visible pointer mode while paused. Pass54 presentation readiness and earlier gameplay contracts remain regressions.
summary: Vector/hardlight combat city with visible field activities, district capture routes, Vector Arena instances, and wireframe health/armor feedback.
name: Utopia Conflict
core_loop: enter the city -> choose a visible field activity or capture route -> fight with hardlight weapons -> secure nodes / open Vector Arena -> earn points -> upgrade body, armor, or ammo -> continue district activities

controls.arena_portal: E enters/exits Vector Arena portal when in range
controls.upgrades: U buys ammo capacity; Shift+U buys health capacity; I buys armor shell capacity using shared points
controls.interact: E starts a nearby visible activity station or enters an open Vector Arena portal; signal fragments can still be walked into or shot
controls.activity_stations: Core Sample and Imploder Study in Calibration; Shield Fracture in High Towers; Magnet Garden in Pyramid Sector

score_rules.score_source: node captures, signal fragments, weapon kills, arena waves, arena clears, chain ruptures, extraction bonus
score_rules.upgrade_spend: shared local points earned in city and arena can be spent on ammo capacity, health capacity, and armor shell capacity

arena_mode.entry: portal opens after a capture node is secured
arena_mode.shared_assets: uses Utopia Conflict weapon/audio systems plus staged Vector Arena SFX

health_and_armor_readability.health_readout: weapon/armor wireframe color gradient, not a health bar
health_and_armor_readability.body_gradient: green full -> amber mid -> red empty
health_and_armor_readability.armor_readout: cyan wireframe shell; hit damage exposes/fades toward current body-health color
